data.name: Indulekha
data.gender_notes: Indulekha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Jewel in the hollow of the eye
data.long_meaning: The name Indulekha is derived from Sanskrit. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl. The name Indulekha can be broken down into two parts. Indu means 'jewel' and lekha means 'hollow of the eye'. The name Indulekha thus signifies 'jewel in the hollow of the eye'. This name is believed to be auspicious and is often given to girls who are believed to be the embodiment of beauty, grace, and intelligence. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Parvati is known to keep the moon in the hollow of her eye. This name is also believed to bestow upon the child the qualities of Parvati, such as beauty, grace, and intelligence.
data.etymology: Indulekha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel in the hollow of the eye.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indulekha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
